result.instructions: Tools for Onfleet, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deliveries are still unassigned for today?"; "Show the status of the task with short ID e5f0cc28."; "Create a destination for our new store and add a delivery task to it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Onfleet data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run onfleet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run onfleet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run onfleet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. onfleet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: onfleet_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks created or completed in a time range. Returns up to 64 tasks per page; pass the returned lastId as lastId to get the next page. Onfleet API: GET /tasks/all.

from.description: Start of the range, Unix ms. Required.

to.description: End of the range, Unix ms. Defaults to now.

lastId.description: Pagination cursor: the lastId from the previous page.

state.description: Comma-separated task states: 0 unassigned, 1 assigned, 2 active, 3 completed.

worker.description: Worker ID assigned to the tasks or who completed them.

tools.name: onfleet_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Get one task by its ID, with its state, destination, recipients and completion details. Onfleet API: GET /tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: onfleet_get_task_by_short_id
tools.title: Get task by short ID
tools.description: Get one task by its short ID (the 8-character code shown in the Onfleet dashboard). Onfleet API: GET /tasks/shortId/{shortId}.

shortId.description: Task short ID, for example e5f0cc28.

tools.name: onfleet_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one delivery order (a pickup task and its dropoff task) by its short ID. Onfleet API: GET /taskOrders/{orderShortId}.

tools.name: onfleet_list_route_plans
tools.title: List route plans
tools.description: List route plans, optionally for one worker. Onfleet API: GET /routePlans.

workerId.description: Only route plans for this worker.

tools.name: onfleet_get_route_plan
tools.title: Get route plan
tools.description: Get one route plan by its ID. Onfleet API: GET /routePlans/{routePlanId}.

tools.name: onfleet_get_delivery_manifest
tools.title: Get delivery manifest
tools.description: Generate the compliance delivery manifest for the tasks on one worker's route at one hub. Onfleet API: GET /integrations/manifest/generate.

tools.name: onfleet_create_destination
tools.title: Create destination
tools.description: Create a delivery destination from an address. Onfleet geocodes the address when no location is given. Returns the destination ID for onfleet_create_task. Onfleet API: POST /destinations.

unparsed.description: One full address in a single string. If set, the other fields are ignored.

country.description: Country name. Required unless unparsed is set.

address.description: Destination address. Use unparsed, or the structured fields.

tools.name: onfleet_create_worker
tools.title: Create worker
tools.description: Create a driver (worker) that belongs to one or more teams. Onfleet API: POST /workers.

phone.description: Phone number in the organization's country format.

teams.description: One or more team IDs the worker belongs to.

description.description: Make, model, year or other details.

vehicle.description: The worker's vehicle. Omit for a worker on foot.

capacity.description: Units the worker can carry, for route optimization.

displayName.description: Name shown in SMS and tracking pages instead of the real name.

tools.name: onfleet_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a delivery task for an existing destination. Recipients may get SMS notifications unless skipped. Create the destination first with onfleet_create_destination. Onfleet API: POST /tasks.

recipientName.description: Recipient name for this task only.

recipientNotes.description: Recipient notes for this task only.

recipientSkipSMSNotifications.description: Skip SMS notifications to the recipient for this task.

pickupTask.description: True if this is a pickup task.

dependencies.description: Task IDs that must complete first.

container.description: Container to add the task to, as in Onfleet's Containers docs. Default: the organization's default container.

quantity.description: Units dropped off at this task, for route optimization.

serviceTime.description: Minutes the worker spends at this destination, for route optimization.

tools.name: onfleet_cancel_orders
tools.title: Cancel orders
tools.description: Cancel delivery orders before they complete. Completed orders cannot be cancelled. Onfleet API: POST /taskOrders/cancel.

tools.name: onfleet_delete_route_plan
tools.title: Delete route plan
tools.description: Delete a route plan. This cannot be undone. Onfleet API: DELETE /routePlans/{routePlanId}.

tools.name: onfleet_update_webhook
tools.title: Update webhook
tools.description: Replace a webhook's settings: its receiving URL, trigger and options. Onfleet API: PUT /webhooks/{webhookId}.

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the webhook POSTs.

trigger.description: Webhook trigger code, as in Onfleet's webhook docs.

scopedApiKeyId.description: Scoped API key ID, or null for none.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Onfleet
prompts.description: What you can do with Onfleet here, with example requests to try.
